Package org.jdesktop.lg3d.dbmanager.model

Class AppSettings

java.lang.Object
org.jdesktop.lg3d.dbmanager.model.AppSettings
public class AppSettings extends Object
Application-wide preferences for the Database Manager, persisted as JSON by ProfileStore.

Every field has a sane default so a fresh install (no settings file yet) works out of the box. The values here are the global defaults; a ConnectionProfile may override the row limit per connection.

    • effectiveRowLimit

      public int effectiveRowLimit(int profileRowLimit)
      The effective row cap for a query: the tighter of the global getMaxRows() and a per-connection limit.
      Parameters:
      profileRowLimit - the profile's row limit (<=0 = uncapped)
      Returns:
      the number of rows to fetch; 0 means no cap
